summary.short_summary: Pixel Eggs is a digital agency founded 14 years ago by Sepas Seraj, specializing in website design and support for purpose-driven organizations, primarily nonprofits. The company, wholly owned by Sepas and his wife, derives 90% of its revenue from this niche, ensuring strong client relationships and minimizing dependency risks. With a balanced revenue mix of £600,000 from retained clients and project work, Pixel Eggs focuses on complex websites requiring tailored solutions. The team, based in Windsor, operates a hybrid model and emphasizes a strong culture of collaboration. Future growth plans include expanding support services and targeting environmental for-profits, while the company prepares for a sale with a valuation goal of £400,000, aligning with its mission-driven ethos.
